properties.name: set_artifact_checksums refuses the WHOLE batch when one item is a never-baselined artifact sent as design_updated — the only legal disposition for it is baseline_established, which the caller could not have chosen otherwise
properties.statement: ① SYMPTOM, dev_storyflow 2026-09-06 on 0.48.0: `link_artifact` without a checksum, then a later batch `set_artifact_checksums` with `design_updated` for it, refused with 'no recorded checksum … pass baseline_established' — 'Correct, and the message said exactly what to do — but the batch is all-or-nothing, so one such item discards the rest.' Ask: infer baseline_established when the artifact has no checksum, or partial-apply with a per-item report. ② PRECEDENT: none for the interaction; the batch's atomicity is deliberate ('ALL OF IT OR NONE OF IT — every item is attempted so you learn every failure at once', and `check_only` exists to rehearse); dec:two-sided-accept forbids a silent disposition; BL-157 made baseline_established the only disposition a checksum-less artifact takes. ③ CANDIDATES: (a) the refusal is right and the cost is the round-trip — the reporter should have used check_only; (b) the per-item disposition is validated without regard to the artifact's state, so a disposition that CANNOT be right for a checksum-less artifact is refused instead of being read as the one that can; (c) atomicity is the cause and partial apply the fix. ④ THE DISCRIMINATING QUESTION: is inferring baseline_established a judgement (which the two-sided rule forbids) or a tautology? For an artifact with NO checksum there is exactly one legal disposition, so passing any other carries no claim the design could disagree with — the caller supplied the digest they read; only the LABEL is wrong. Inferring the label is not a silent accept: nothing about the design's position is chosen on the caller's behalf, and the reply can say per item 'recorded as baseline_established: this artifact had no checksum'. (c) would weaken the batch's stated contract for every other failure and is not needed. ⑤ MEASURED here only on the record: 2 of 398 artifacts in reflow2's own design still carry no checksum (art:foundation, art:storyflow-engineering-principles), so the case is live on this design too. ⑧ FIX SHAPE (not taken here): in set_artifact_checksum(s), when the artifact has no checksum and the disposition is design_updated or design_holds, record baseline_established and say so in that item's reply; keep all-or-nothing for every other refusal. ⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether a design_updated on a first baseline should ALSO draw the CHANGED edge to the named change event (a first baseline is 'nothing moved', so probably not), which is the one place inference could assert something.
properties.value: {"reported":"2026-09-06 dev_storyflow on 0.48.0","cause":"per-item disposition validated without the artifact's state; the one legal disposition is refused rather than read","fix_shape":"read design_updated/design_holds on a checksum-less artifact as baseline_established and say so per item","keep":"all-or-nothing for every other refusal; check_only unchanged","checksumless_here":2}
